make_or_buy_basis: Per-car 800 V-class traction, auxiliary, PV, and station-interface electronics; no central AC bus.

material_spec.finish_or_protection: UV/weather protection, hot-surface labelling, and galvanic isolation where required
material_spec.form_factor: module, thermal shield, aluminum/stainless clamp hardware, and UV-rated harness
material_spec.governing_standard: supplier datasheet plus project bonding, isolation, fire, and vibration evidence
material_spec.grade_or_part_class: PV module / resistor / clamp / isolator kit
material_spec.nominal_section: roof keep-out, clamp pitch, and thermal clearance frozen by RFQ drawing
material_spec.traceability: module serials, resistance/PV flash data, CoC, and harness batch

joining_methods: sealed, gasketed, bonded, or clipped interface as supplier envelope requires
process_spec.release_level: BID supplier-controlled process; OSR controls envelope and acceptance evidence

fit_gaps: The ABB platform is a rail-qualified architecture anchor, not proof that one published configuration meets the LM3 800 V LFP, 225 kWh/car, side-pin charging, packaging or price targets.
supplier_anchor.localisation: Treat each converter, battery, charger/contact system and protection panel as separable behind frozen DC-link, cooling, HVIL, network and mechanical interfaces; qualify lower-cost local modules one at a time.
mandatory_equivalence: same or better released fit, mounting datums, connector keying and service envelope
same or better mass, load, duty-cycle, thermal, electrical and environmental ratings
same or better functional safety, fire, EMC, cybersecurity and applicable rail evidence
documented failure modes, maintenance intervals, spares and obsolescence route
first-article inspection plus component, subassembly and vehicle regression tests
signed design-authority substitution record preserving the original anchor and evidence hashes
supplier_anchor.product_family: BORDLINE CC400/ESC/PB and Traction Battery Pro reference platform
supplier_anchor.release_boundary: A web page is not a purchase specification. Design authority must freeze the exact supplier part number, configuration, drawings, software, evidence, commercial terms and spares through RFQ before release. Safety-critical substitutes require calculation, test, independent assessment and authority acceptance.
